comment: 151 (sv3pt5): Common/Uncommon/Rare cards also exist as Poke Ball and Master Ball pattern reverse holos, which are not modelled as TCGplayer price keys.
Prismatic Evolutions (sv8pt5): same Poke Ball / Master Ball pattern gimmick as 151.

Legendary Collection (base6): every card was printed with a reverse-holo treatment, but TCGCSV's published feed is missing the Reverse Holofoil sub_type for 8 cards (Dark Blastoise, Muk, Jynx, Kakuna, Meowth, Abra, Eevee, Squirtle as of 2026-05-30). Idempotent: cards that already have reverse_holo via TCGCSV are no-ops; the gap cards get a printing with NULL product_id, falling through to manual_prices. See pokedumpster-28f.
